name: Nimrael Reedwake
source_profile:
Elder Nimrael Reedwake (LG)

Nimrael is an elderly but energetic leader who believes the expanding Cadorian frontier presents both dangers and opportunities. She favors negotiated boundaries, commercial agreements, and carefully managed trade. She is particularly interested in arranging reciprocal livestock and grain markets with the settlers of Redvale. She has found Marquis Garrus Ashford surprisingly approachable, although she remains deeply suspicious of his territorial ambitions.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 66 (source excerpt; may be partial)
